This replaces m|b|^2 in the signed L2 selector by the strictly smaller (m-1+|c|^(2s))|b|^2 whenever b is nonzero. The inequality is optimal from cardinality and product alone: equality occurs on the closed cube at x_1=...=x_(m-1)=1, x_m=P, and open-cube families approach it.
